Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a volume of 19890 pcs per year at a price of €32.20 per unit. The requested contract term is 12 months, and our Lieferzeit is 54 days. 

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days. We look forward to proceeding according to our standard commercial procedure upon receipt of your confirmation.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH

move.subject: Re: Ravensteiner cuts the seal allocation
move.body:
Dear Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH team,

Your earlier messages link additional capacity to binding commitment—it sounds like planning certainty is central to what you can allocate. We are ready to commit long-term so you can plan capacity reliably and we can secure our full requirement. How can we turn that commitment into a confirmed allocation covering our full demand?

We confirm a binding volume of 23,400 units per year for 36 months. Our demand forecast for Mechanical seal 24 mm is up +10.1% (fc:340010@2026-09). We understand a change of this size needs your pricing committee; please put this proposal to them.

On this basis we propose the attached term sheets (EUR 27.38 per unit, 23,400 units a year, 36 months, 56 days lead time). Please let us know which option works best for you.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We note your request for an increased allocation of 23,400 units over a 36-month term. 

This is our final offer (letztes Angebot). Please decide. We can secure this volume and the 56-day lead time at a unit price of EUR 32.00. 

For clarity, our Angebot comprises a price of €32.00 per unit, Lieferzeit 56 days, a volume of 23400 pcs per year, and a contract term of 36 months. Our Lieferzeit is 56 days. This offer remains valid for 7 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Monika Zellner
Segment Manager, Dichtungswerk Ravensteiner GmbH
